issue: i am in US Virgin Islands and the merchant is saying i have to spend minimum 10$ on my VISA card, why so?
subject: Visa card minimum spend
response: Under Visa's network rules, merchants in the United States and US territories — including the US Virgin Islands — are not permitted to impose a minimum transaction amount on Visa credit card purchases. The merchant requiring a $10 minimum is violating Visa's merchant agreement. You can report this to Visa by calling +1-800-847-2911.
justification: Visa prohibits minimum spend requirements in the US and US territories; informed user the merchant is violating Visa rules.
